children.game_version: Rhythm tap game copying the fiddle sound with heel and toe taps.

seniors.seated_version: Perform heel taps, toe taps, and rhythm shuffles seated in a sturdy chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform foot taps holding a chair back for support without jumping.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo using clog half-time rhythm and small foot movement range.

learning_units.description: Basic percussive tap combination featuring heel tap, toe tap, and shuffle.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Flowing arm movements or hands on hips
movement_profile.footwork: Heel taps, toe taps, and shuffles in small space with limited lateral movement
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo percussive stepdance performed in a small space
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Steps danced high off the floor in Ottawa Valley style

signature_moves.description: Variable steps danced high off the floor incorporating tap dance elements.
signature_moves.name: Ottawa Valley aggressive step

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fast and lively for reels, energetic march feel for jigs, graceful half-time for clogs
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Excessive lateral movement or tense, rigid upper body posture.

music_profile.musical_form: Reels, jigs, strathspeys, clogs, hornpipes, two-steps, polkas
music_profile.sound_description: Bright, melodic Celtic fiddle music driving acoustic percussive foot taps and shuffles.

teaching.formation: Solo stepdance in a small space with limited lateral movement
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on clear heel taps, toe taps, and shuffles while keeping upper body relaxed and upright in a compact space.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 for reels, 6/8 for jigs, half-time for clogs
